_meta.notes: All eight RAW divine activities surfaced via the Faith block. restricted_period_rounds values: daily = 8640, weekly = 60480, monthly = 241920, yearly = 3144960 (ROUNDS_PER_DAY × N). Per Q11 [RESOLVED 2026-05-10], divine casters with full spell_research also get the Magical Research bucket — magical research/scribing/etc. are NOT surfaced here; they live in the Magical Research block (Phase 10B.1) for these classes.

param_schema.gp_committed: int (wages spent on missionary hirelings this month; accrues into next-month congregant growth)

activities.effect_summary: Dispatch hirelings to perform evangelical deeds. gp committed accrues into next month's congregant growth roll (1d10 + Cha mod per 1,000 gp).

param_schema.spell_keys: Array[String] — keys of spells cast charitably this session
param_schema.gp_value_total: int (sum of spell-cost gp values, accrues into next-month congregant growth)

activities.effect_summary: Cast daily spells for charitable purposes. gp value of cast spells accrues into next month's congregant growth.

param_schema.gp_invested: int (gp value of the altar; 1 day per 500 gp)
param_schema.dp_substituted_gp: int (optional; gp substituted from divine_power per RAW §consecrate_altar L419 'humbler-looking altar')
param_schema.alignment: lawful | neutral | chaotic (must match caster's deity)

activities.effect_summary: Consecrates an altar. Aura size = 100 sq ft per 100 gp invested. Lawful altars create a pinnacle of good; chaotic create a sinkhole of evil. Aura persists until dispelled or altar is physically broken and blessed.
Consecrates the fields. On completion: spend 2 gp DP per family, make magic-research throw. Success → +1 gp/family land value during next month's revenue. Natural 1 → -1 gp/family.

Spend DP equal to ruler's monthly domain revenue. Magic-research throw. Success: +1 base morale, +1 vassal loyalty, best-of-two vagary rolls for 12 game months. Natural 1: -1 base morale, -1 vassal loyalty, worst-of-two vagary rolls.

Extract 10 gp DP per 50 congregants (= congregants ÷ 5). If caster is ruler/spiritual_advisor of a domain, additionally roll 0..8 gp per 10 families. DP is NOT auto-accumulated; activity must be taken weekly per RAW §extract_divine_power L472.

param_schema.sacrifice_target_ids: Array[String] (creatures sacrificed; up to class_level per session)

activities.effect_summary: Conduct one blood sacrifice per class level per session. Each sacrifice generates DP equal to the XP value of the sacrificed creature.

param_schema.gp_value_total: int (gp value of ceremonial offerings; accrues into next-month congregant growth)

activities.effect_summary: Perform ceremonial sacrifices. gp value of offerings accrues into next month's congregant growth.
